info.title: Spine API
info.description: Security Orchestration, Automation and Response — see docs/architecture/api-contract.md

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description: Rate limited per IP and per username (429 + Retry-After). Every failure returns 401 "invalid credentials". Sets the `spine_refresh` cookie.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh cookie and get a new access token
post.description: Needs the `spine_refresh` cookie, `X-Spine-CSRF: 1` and an allowed Origin. Presenting an already-used token revokes the whole token family.

post.summary: Log out: revoke the refresh-token family and clear the cookie

post.description: 409 if the email exists (case-insensitive). 400 if the password fails the policy.

patch.summary: Change a user’s role, display name, or disabled flag
patch.description: 409 if the change would leave no active admin.

get.description: `action` is a prefix filter, e.g. `auth.` or `PATCH /api/v1/users`.

post.summary: Submit one canonical alert (optional Idempotency-Key header)

get.summary: Alert detail with enrichments, score explanation and playbook runs

patch.summary: Triage an alert: status (validated transitions), assignee, case

post.summary: Create a case and link alerts to it

get.summary: A case with its linked alerts

patch.summary: Update a case; link or unlink alerts

post.summary: Bulk import: one record per line (ndjson, cef or suricata-eve); partial success
Webhook ingestion, authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 (X-Spine-Timestamp, X-Spine-Signature)
